list.en: The Qingming Festival is in spring

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: We eat Qingming dumplings. Try some!

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: We have the Qingming Festival in spring. We eat Qingming dumplings.
list.cn: 我们在春天过清明节。我们吃清明果。

list.name: Hanghang's sister：
list.en: We have the Dragon Boat Festival in summer. We eat zongzi.
list.cn: 我们在夏天过端午节。我们吃粽子。

list.name: Hanghang's mother：
list.en: We have the Mid-Autumn Day in autumn. We eat mooncakes.
list.cn: 我们在秋天过中秋节。我们吃月饼。

list.name: Hanghang's father：
list.en: We have the Spring Festival in winter. We eat spring rolls.
list.cn: 我们在冬天过春节。我们吃春卷。

list.name: Zhouzhou：
list.en: The Dragon Boat Festival is in summer. We eat zongzi.
list.cn: 端午节在夏天。我们吃粽子。
